message: Last winter, we got caught in a surprise storm that turned our cozy little town into a winter wonderland—complete with unexpected road closures. Luckily, I had brushed up on some tips about winter weather preparedness. It turned out to be a small win that saved the day! I had supplies ready, which made the whole experience a bit more manageable and even a little fun. Have you ever had a moment where being prepared made all the difference?
